title: Generative Pre-training for Speech with Flow Matching

layout.note: Two unlabelled columns divided by a black vertical rule: at left a flow-path sketch (x_0 to x_1) beside a Random θ network column, at right a Pre-trained θ column; each column reads bottom-up from stacked inputs through a network box and an output formula to a loss label, and a dashed arrow crosses the rule from one box to the other.

lesson: Show a pretrain-then-finetune recipe by drawing the same network box once per stage with only its weights label (Random θ, Pre-trained θ) and the bottom input changed, split by a vertical rule and tied by one dashed arrow; the swapped input and the named loss above each box show the difference without extra text.
